The '''Latarl Farmstead''' was a [[windfarm]], part of the [[Breezefield Farms]] complex located in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was occupied by [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]<ref name="TOR:BF" /> until the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] drove them out to occupy their nearby [[Gamorrean Bunker|base]].<ref name="TOR:DC">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Desert Conquest|Tatooine}}</ref>
